mechanism: Testosterone may antagonize the antihypertensive effects of candesartan through sympathomimetic and sodium-retaining properties, while candesartan may increase serum potassium levels which could be exacerbated by testosterone's potential effects on renal function.
action: Monitor blood pressure and serum potassium levels regularly; adjust candesartan dose if needed and counsel on sodium restriction; consider alternative therapies if hypertension control becomes inadequate.
